questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "anchor" mean?
options: to keep something stable or steady
questions.explain_en: Here "anchor" means TSMC helps keep the index stable and high.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「anchor」指的是台積電讓指數保持穩定且偏高。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's raised outlook keeps heavyweights leading the index

questions.question: What full-year revenue growth target did TSMC set?
questions.explain_en: The summary says TSMC lifted its full-year revenue growth target to about 44%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到台積電把全年營收成長目標提升至約44%。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's raised outlook keeps heavyweights leading the index

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "bottleneck" mean?
options: A point that speeds up the process
A problem that slows down the process
questions.explain_en: Here "bottleneck" refers to a limitation that slows down the flow of AI accelerator shipments.
questions.explain_zh: 在此句中，「bottleneck」指的是阻礙 AI 加速器出貨的瓶頸問題。
questions.news_title_en: CoWoS capacity accelerates on AI orders

questions.question: By the end of 2027, how many CoWoS wafers per month does TSMC expect to produce?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the capacity will be about 170k wafers per month by the end of 2027.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明到 2027 年底，TSMC 的產能約為每月 17 萬片。
questions.news_title_en: CoWoS capacity accelerates on AI orders

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "deploy" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "deploy" means to invest or use capital for a purpose.
questions.explain_zh: 在此句中，「deploy」指的是投資或使用資金以達成目的。
questions.news_title_en: FSC opens insurers to health-and-wellness investments

questions.question: According to the summary, what is the maximum stake insurers can now take?
questions.explain_en: The text says insurers can take stakes of up to 100%.
questions.explain_zh: 文章指出，保險公司現在可以持有最高 100% 的股份。
questions.news_title_en: FSC opens insurers to health-and-wellness investments

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "exemption" mean?
options: A rule that must be followed
A permission to ignore a rule
questions.explain_en: An exemption is a permission to not follow a specific rule.
questions.explain_zh: 「exemption」指的是允許不遵守特定規則的許可。
questions.news_title_en: FSC relaxes rules for wealth-management insurance products

questions.question: Who is the target audience for the newly flexible wealth‑management insurance products?
questions.explain_en: The summary says the products are aimed at affluent clients.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說這些產品是為富裕客戶設計的。
questions.news_title_en: FSC relaxes rules for wealth-management insurance products

questions.question: In the summary, what does the term "deemed‑estate" mean?
options: A type of investment fund in Taiwan
Property that is considered part of the estate for tax purposes
A gift that is given after the donor dies
An estate that has been legally approved by the court
questions.explain_en: A "deemed‑estate" is property treated as belonging to the estate for tax calculation, even if it was given as a gift before death.
questions.explain_zh: 「deemed‑estate」指的是即使是死亡前的贈與，也被視為遺產的一部份，用來計算稅金。

questions.question: According to the summary, what was the estate‑tax revenue in 2025?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that estate‑tax revenue hit a record NT$44.33 billion in 2025.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到 2025 年遺產稅收入創下新高，為新台幣 44.33 億元。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "surge" mean?
questions.explain_en: The text says "AI-led export surge," meaning exports are rising quickly and sharply.
questions.explain_zh: 文中「AI-led export surge」指的是出口快速大幅上升。
questions.news_title_en: DGBAS lifts 2026 growth forecast to a near-40-year high

questions.question: What is the projected CPI for Taiwan in 2026 according to the summary?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the 2026 CPI is expected to be 2.07%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明 2026 年的 CPI 預估為 2.07%。
questions.news_title_en: DGBAS lifts 2026 growth forecast to a near-40-year high
